name: Khalifa University of Science and Technology
englishBachelors: English-medium BSc degrees in engineering, computing, mathematics and science. See the current catalogue for programmes beyond the examples below.
note: A research university in Abu Dhabi built around energy, aerospace and AI. It asks for 24 IB points with at least 4 in all six subjects, charges AED 2,500 per credit hour (about AED 81,250 a year) and considers merit scholarships from the admission application.
summary: Abu Dhabi research university offering BSc degrees in engineering, computing, mathematics and science, with competitive entry and limited merit scholarships.
about: First-year general education is based at Main Campus on Abu Dhabi Island. KU also operates Sas Al Nakhl Campus on the mainland, where student housing is available.

ib.text: Full Diploma, six HL/SL subjects, at least 4 in each and 24 points; Maths plus Physics for most engineering (Physics, Biology or Chemistry for some). No Course Results route is published.

notes: KU requires the full IB Diploma with 24 points, at least 4 in each of six HL/SL subjects and Maths plus the science required for your degree. One section also lists English Language as an IB subject; the summary table does not. Confirm the English subject rule and which IB Maths pathway KU accepts. No standalone Course Results route is published.

Meeting the minimum does not guarantee admission. Shortlisted applicants may sit KU tests in person; strong applicants may be exempt. Admissions also describes a recorded video assessment. The Fall 2027 eligibility table says school graduation must be in 2025 or later.

Most engineering degrees, Robotics and AI, and Applied Mathematics require Maths and Physics. For Cell and Molecular Biology, take Maths plus Chemistry or Biology. For Computer Science, take Maths plus Physics, Chemistry or Biology. The published IB threshold for programme subjects is 4.
English proof is separate: Academic IELTS 6.0 or TOEFL iBT 79. The admissions FAQ says all applicants must submit one; do not assume an IB English grade waives it.

International applicants inside or outside the UAE use the KU portal, which lists 2 November 2026 to 1 February 2027. If final grades are not ready, submit first-term Grade 12 marks, or a school predicted-grade letter if those marks have not been issued. Ask your IB coordinator to send final results. Foreign school certificates require UAE equivalency. A decision date is not published; any seat-holding deadline is given in your offer.

Published tuition is AED 2,500 per credit. KU estimates about AED 81,250 per year for a typical four-year BSc, not a guaranteed Fall 2027 quote. The standard fall/spring housing rates are AED 10,000 per term (shared) or AED 20,000 (single occupancy). If charged, the AED 5,000 undergraduate seat deposit normally falls due five working days after the offer letter; check your own offer.

Scholarships: international students are assessed during admission and mapped to a merit scholarship tier; there is no separate scholarship application and slots are limited. Details of tiers should be checked on the scholarships page.
The 2026–27 KU catalogue identifies English as the usual teaching and examination language, with exceptions such as Arabic-language courses.
KU describes advanced-standing credit for selected IB HL exams with marks of 6 or above. This is separate from admission, not a rule that all applicants need HL 6.
The photograph above shows Abu Dhabi city context, not the campus. Use KU’s Main Campus guide to see the campus and its aerospace labs; KU lists student housing at Sas Al Nakhl.
For Aerospace Engineering, see KU’s four-year study plan and the active CAA accreditation listing below. KU also lists Maths and Physics for this degree.
